projects.name: Sonic
projects.longDescription: Sonic is a lightning-fast data processing engine built for real-time analytics. It handles massive datasets with ease, delivering insights in milliseconds rather than minutes. Perfect for applications where speed is critical.
projects.additionalDescription: Performance was not just a feature for Sonic — it was the entire product. Every line of code was scrutinized for efficiency. We used memory-mapped files, SIMD instructions, and custom data structures to squeeze every bit of performance from the hardware.
highlights: Achieved sub-millisecond query latency on billion-row datasets
Built a columnar storage engine optimized for analytical queries
Implemented vectorized query execution for maximum throughput
Created a distributed architecture for horizontal scaling

projects.name: Scalar
projects.longDescription: Scalar creates beautiful, interactive API documentation that developers love. It makes it easy to create, maintain, and share comprehensive API documentation with your team, transforming OpenAPI specs into stunning documentation pages.
projects.additionalDescription: Documentation is often an afterthought, but it is the first thing developers see when evaluating an API. Scalar was built on the belief that great documentation should be effortless to create and a pleasure to read. Every design decision was made with both the documentation author and the API consumer in mind.
highlights: Built an OpenAPI 3.1 parser with comprehensive spec validation
Created an interactive API playground for testing endpoints
Implemented automatic code generation in 10+ programming languages
Designed a theming system matching any brand identity
